text: Fenton Meiks walks into an FBI office in Dallas and tells Agent Doyle that his brother Adam was the God's Hand killer. He recounts the summer of 1979 in Thurman, Texas, when their widowed father, a mechanic, woke them to say [an angel had shown him demons wearing human faces|trigger|strange signs and visions]. With an axe named Otis and [a list of names|rules|it chooses who dies], he [makes his boys help bury the bodies|threat|people in your own life] in the rose garden behind their cottage, and Fenton begins to fear what the angel says about him.
